title: TSMC invests €1.11B in ASML for 5% stake
body: TSMC agreed to invest €838 million for a 5% equity stake and €276 million in R&D in ASML, totaling €1.114 billion, to fund next-generation lithography including 450mm wafer tools.

context.text: TSMC eyes future technology with $1.4bn ASML investment
why: The €1.1B ASML investment secured early access to next-generation 450mm wafer tools, strengthening TSMC's long-term manufacturing cost leadership.
date evidence (day)

title: Morris Chang announces June 2018 retirement
body: TSMC founder Morris Chang announced on October 2, 2017 that he would retire as chairman after the Annual Shareholders Meeting in early June 2018, ending over 30 years of leadership.

context.text: Semiconductor Industry To Lose Titan As Morris Chang Sets TSMC Retirement Date
why: It set the timeline for founder Morris Chang's exit and the leadership transition to Mark Liu and C.C. Wei.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC WannaCry Variant Virus Outbreak at Fabs
body: A WannaCry variant infected TSMC's fab tools on August 3, 2018, causing shutdowns and a recognized loss of NT$2,596.0 million (about US$85 million), not $256 million.

context.text: TSMC Chip Maker Blames WannaCry Malware for Production Halt
why: A ransomware attack halted multiple fabs and cost TSMC about $256 million in revenue, marking a rare operational disruption with direct financial impact.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Approves $3.5B Arizona Subsidiary
body: TSMC's board approved a $3.5 billion paid-in capital investment to establish a wholly-owned subsidiary, TSMC Arizona Corporation, in Arizona, United States.

context.text: TSMC Approves $3.5 Billion Capital Investment For Subsidiary In Arizona
why: TSMC formalized a $3.5B subsidiary to execute its Arizona gigafab, advancing geographic diversification and U.S. subsidy access.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Announces $100B Three-Year Investment Plan
body: TSMC announced it expects to invest $100 billion over the next three years to increase capacity and support R&D of advanced semiconductor technologies amid a global chip shortage.

context.text: Taiwanese chip-maker announces $100bn investment
why: TSMC committed $100B over three years to expand capacity, reshaping its long-term supply and growth outlook amid a global chip shortage.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC notifies customers of 10-20% price hikes
body: On August 25, 2021, TSMC notified customers of about 10% price hikes for sub-16nm processes and up to 20% for 16nm and above, with new prices effective for orders from December 2021.

context.text: TSMC to raise quotes for advanced, mature process technologies by 10-20%
why: The price hikes directly improved TSMC's expected margins and revenue outlook starting December 2021.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Announces Japan 22/28nm Fab Plan
body: TSMC announced it would build a 22/28-nanometer fab in Japan with production targeted by end of 2024 and Japanese government support.

context.text: TSMC to Build Chip Fab in Japan
why: It marked TSMC's concrete entry into Japanese manufacturing, diversifying geographic risk and expanding its long-term capacity footprint.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q2 2022 Revenue $18.16B
body: TSMC announced Q2 2022 revenue of US$18.16 billion, up 36.6% year-over-year, supported by HPC, IoT and automotive demand.

context.text: TSMC: Life’s A Beach, And Then You Make Dies
why: Q2 2022 revenue of $18.16B with 36.3% YoY growth confirmed strong HPC demand ahead of the AI boom.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Announces $40B Arizona Investment
body: TSMC announced a $40 billion investment in two Arizona fabs, the largest foreign direct investment in Arizona history.

context.text: How TSMC’s AZ semiconductor plants will benefit U.S.
why: Materially expanded TSMC's U.S. manufacturing footprint and committed capital that reshaped its geopolitical and capacity outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Raises Arizona Investment to $65B
body: TSMC increased its planned U.S. investment from $40 billion to $65 billion and announced a third Phoenix fab under a CHIPS Act preliminary agreement.

context.text: TSMC Accelerates Nearshoring to Diversify Away from China
why: TSMC materially expanded its U.S. manufacturing commitment by $25B, reshaping its geopolitical and capacity outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q2 2024 Profit Beats, Capex Narrowed
body: TSMC reported Q2 2024 revenue of NT$673.51 billion, beating expectations on strong AI chip demand, and narrowed its 2024 capex to US$30–32 billion.

context.text: TSMC second-quarter profit beats expectations as AI chip boom continues
why: TSMC's Q2 2024 results beat profit expectations on AI demand and narrowed 2024 capex guidance to $30–32 billion, refining the investment outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC $100B for Five New US Fabs
body: TSMC announced a $100 billion investment to build five additional cutting-edge chip fabrication facilities in Arizona, bringing its total U.S. investment to $165 billion.

context.text: Trump, Taiwanese chipmaker announce new $100 billion plan to build five new US factories
why: TSMC committed $100B to five new US fabs, materially expanding its geopolitical diversification and long-term capacity outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Breaks Ground on Third Phoenix Fab
body: TSMC broke ground on its third Phoenix fabrication facility as part of a $165 billion U.S. investment announced March 4, 2025.

context.text: TSMC breaks ground on 3rd fabrication facility in Phoenix
why: Construction start on the third Phoenix fab advances TSMC's $165B U.S. expansion and geographic diversification.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q2 2025 Profit Surges 60.7% to Record
body: TSMC announced on July 17, 2025 a 60.7% year-on-year Q2 net profit increase to a historic high, driven by AI and HPC demand, with Q3 revenue forecast at $31.8B–$33.0B.

context.text: TSMC profit surges 61% to record high fueled by AI chip demand
why: Record Q2 profit and raised Q3 guidance confirm AI-driven earnings momentum materially lifting TSM's outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: Taiwan says TSMC exempt from US chip tariffs
body: Taiwan's National Development Council minister Liu Chin-ching said at a parliamentary briefing on August 7, 2025 that TSMC is exempt from the US 100% semiconductor tariff because it has factories in the United States.

context.text: TSMC gets a reprieve from Trump's 100% chip tariffs thanks to its U.S. factories, Taiwan says
why: Exemption from proposed 100% US chip tariffs removes a major potential cost and competitive threat to TSMC's exports.
date evidence (day)

title: US revokes TSMC Nanjing VEU status
body: The U.S. revoked TSMC's validated end-user authorization for its Nanjing, China plant effective December 31, 2025, requiring export licenses for U.S. chipmaking equipment.

context.text: US revokes TSMC's authorisation on China-bound tech
why: The US revocation of TSMC's China tech export license threatens to disrupt its China operations and restrict technology transfers.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC plans $38B–$42B capex for 2025
body: TSMC projected 2025 capital expenditure of $38 billion to $42 billion, surpassing analyst estimates, to meet surging AI-driven semiconductor demand.

context.text: The Silicon Frontier: How Advanced Manufacturing is Powering AI’s Unprecedented Ascent - FinancialContent
why: TSMC raised planned capex to $38B–$42B, signaling a major multi-year capacity expansion for AI and 2nm.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC applies for 1.4nm Taichung A14 fab
body: TSMC submitted an application to the Central Taiwan Science Park Bureau on October 17, 2025 to build a 1.4nm A14 fab in Taichung with an initial investment of about NT$1.5 trillion (US$49 billion) and mass production targeted for the second half of 2028.

context.text: TSMC applies to build 1.4nm process fab in Taichung - Taiwan News
why: TSMC committed to a $49B 1.4nm fab that extends its process leadership and capacity into 2028.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC trade secret theft legal dispute
body: Taiwanese authorities detained three people for allegedly stealing TSMC chip trade secrets, and TSMC launched legal proceedings after detecting unauthorized activities.

context.text: Why TSM Stock Is Poised For A Rebound?
why: A legal dispute over a production-secrets breach creates IP-protection and operational-risk exposure for TSMC.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q4 2025 Revenue NT$1.046T, Up 20.5%
body: TSMC announced on January 15, 2026 that Q4 2025 consolidated revenue was NT$1,046.09 billion, a 20.5% increase year-over-year driven by strong demand for leading-edge process technologies.

context.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Q4 Revenue Jumps 20%, Tops Forecasts
why: Q4 2025 revenue of NT$1.046T confirmed record annual growth driven by AI demand, materially validating TSM's earnings trajectory.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC sets 2026 capex at $52B–$56B
body: TSMC announced on January 15, 2026 it plans $52 billion–$56 billion in 2026 capital spending, up 27%–37% from $40.9 billion in 2025, to meet AI demand and expand U.S. capacity.

context.text: US and Taiwan sign $250B trade deal, cutting tariffs on Taiwanese goods
why: TSMC raised 2026 capex to $52B–$56B, a 40% increase signaling a major multi-year capacity expansion for AI and U.S. fabs.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC $165B US Investment and 2025 Revenue
body: TSMC announced a $165 billion U.S. investment including Arizona fabs on March 4, 2025, and later reported $122.42 billion 2025 revenue, up 35.9% year-over-year.

context.text: This Stock Is Vital to the Tech Industry and Could Be a Huge Winner This Year
why: Confirmed record 2025 revenue and formalized the $165B U.S. investment, materially expanding TSMC's long-term capacity and geographic footprint.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC to make 3nm chips in Kumamoto Japan
body: TSMC announced on Feb. 5, 2026 it will produce 3-nanometer chips at its second Kumamoto plant with planned investment of ¥2.6 trillion ($17 billion) and Japanese government support, upgrading from the original 7nm plan.

context.text: TSMC Plans $17 Billion Japan Expansion With Advanced 3nm Chips As Tokyo Ramps Up Subsidies - Apple  ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) , NVIDIA  ( NASDAQ:NVDA )
why: A $17B Japan 3nm expansion shifts TSMC's Kumamoto site to advanced nodes, significantly enlarging its global advanced-capacity base.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC begins 2nm chip volume production
body: TSMC officially began volume production of its 2nm chips in Q4 2025, with production centered at Fab 22 in Kaohsiung using first-generation nanosheet transistor technology.

context.text: TSMC Starts 2 Nanometer Era As AI Demand Reframes Valuation
why: Commencement of 2nm production marks TSM's most advanced node reaching revenue-generating scale amid surging AI demand.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q1 2026 Revenue NT$1.13T, Up 35%
body: TSMC announced on April 10, 2026 that Q1 2026 revenue was NT$1,134.10 billion (about $35.6 billion), a 35.1% year-on-year increase driven by AI chip demand.

context.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Stock Climbs On Record Q1 Revenue Jump Of 35%
why: Record Q1 revenue of $35.6B up 35% confirms AI-driven growth is accelerating into 2026.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q1 2026 Net Profit Up 58% to Record
body: TSMC announced on April 16, 2026 that Q1 2026 net income rose 58.3% year-over-year to NT$572.48 billion, a record, supported by strong AI chip demand.

context.text: TSMC Q1 profit jumps 58% to record, beats expectations
why: A 58% Q1 profit surge to a record beat forecasts and signals strong margin expansion from AI.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Debuts A13, A12 and CoWoS Expansion
body: TSMC announced A13 and A12 process nodes for 2029 volume production alongside expansion of CoWoS to 14 reticles in 2028 and a co-packaged optics solution using COUPE on substrate beginning production in 2026.

context.text: TSMC’s next-generation chip coming in 2029
why: Unveiling A13/A12 nodes and CoWoS expansion sets TSMC's 2029 product and packaging roadmap and capacity.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Exits Arm Stake With $231M Sale
body: TSMC's subsidiary TSMC Partners sold 1.11 million Arm shares at $207.65 each for about $231 million, fully divesting its remaining stake per an April 29, 2026 company filing.

context.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing exits Arm Holdings with $231M share sale
why: Full divestment of Arm stake for $231M realizes an 85% profit and simplifies TSMC's investment portfolio.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC approves $31.28B capital appropriation
body: TSMC's board approved capital appropriations of approximately US$31,284.30 million for advanced technology capacity and fab construction on May 12, 2026.

context.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Sees Global Chip Market Hitting $1.5 Trillion By 2030 Amid AI Boom - Taiwan Semicond
why: TSMC's board approved $31.28B in capacity expansion through 2030, materially increasing its committed capital and long-term production footprint.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC approves $20B injection to Arizona subsidiary
body: TSMC's board approved a capital injection of up to US$20 billion into wholly owned subsidiary TSMC Arizona on May 12, 2026, but did not raise its 2026 revenue growth outlook to over 30%.

context.text: Buy TSM Below $400
why: TSMC raised its 2026 revenue growth outlook above 30% and authorized a $20B Arizona capital injection, significantly expanding US commitments and forward guidance.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC and Amkor Sign 10-Year Packaging Deal
body: TSMC and Amkor announced a 10-year agreement for TSMC to procure advanced packaging and testing services from Amkor in Arizona.

context.text: Amkor Technology Inc Stock (AMKR) Moved Up by 7.42% on Jun 16: Key Drivers Unveiled
why: A 10-year Amkor packaging deal secures advanced backend capacity for TSMC's Arizona campus, supporting U.S. output and customer commitments.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q2 2026 Net Income Up 77.4% YoY
body: TSMC announced on July 16, 2026 that its Q2 2026 net income was NT$706.56 billion, up 77.4% year-over-year, with revenue of NT$1,270.38 billion.

context.text: Here Is the 1 Dirt-Cheap Semiconductor Titan I Keep Loading Up on Repeat
why: TSMC reported another record-scale quarter with 43.82% net income growth, confirming continued AI-driven earnings momentum for investors.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC to build 3 Chiayi packaging fabs
body: At the July 12, 2026 groundbreaking for Chiayi Science Park Phase II, NSTC Minister Wu Cheng-wen said TSMC would build three additional advanced packaging facilities there to meet growing global demand for HPC chips and advanced packaging.

context.text: TSMC to build 3 new packaging fabs in Chiayi Science Park's Phase II
why: TSMC committed to three new Chiayi advanced packaging fabs, directly expanding its AI/HPC packaging capacity.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC raises US investment to $265B
body: TSMC announced an incremental $100 billion investment, raising its total planned U.S. investment to $265 billion for 12 advanced semiconductor and packaging facilities in Arizona.

context.text: Made in America, Built by Taiwan: Inside Trump’s New AI Superchip Supply Chain
why: TSMC raised its total U.S. investment to $265B, materially expanding its long-term capacity and geopolitical footprint.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC raises 2026 capex to $60B-$64B
body: TSMC raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to between $60 billion and $64 billion from $52 billion–$56 billion due to surging AI demand.

context.text: Why AMD Stock Is Falling Premarket Today Despite Fresh Price Target Hikes
why: TSMC lifted 2026 capex to $60B–$64B, signaling stronger AI-driven capacity build-out than previously guided.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC unveils A14 process ahead of schedule
body: TSMC unveiled its A14 process on April 23, 2025, stating development was progressing smoothly with yield performance ahead of schedule, with production planned for 2028.

context.text: How TSMC is Advancing its A14 Technology Roadmap for AI Transformation
why: A14 pre-production moved to 2027 and volume to 2028, pulling forward TSMC's most advanced node and reshaping its technology outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC and Sony Sign JV Agreement for Image Sensors
body: TSMC and Sony signed a definitive agreement to establish a Kumamoto joint venture for smartphone image sensors with TSMC investing approximately 282 billion yen.

context.text: TSMC & Sony Establish JV in Japan to Develop Smartphone Image Sensors
why: TSMC committed ~$1.9B for a 40% stake in a Sony JV, diversifying into image sensor manufacturing with 2029 production.
